name: Fractal Explorer
description: Explore Mandelbrot and Julia fractals offline with anchored zoom, pan, favorite views and PNG export
help: The mouse wheel zooms anchored at the pointer and dragging pans the view; double-click in the Mandelbrot view to pick a c parameter and switch to Julia.
Black pixels mean the orbit did not escape within the iteration limit — an observation of this run, not a mathematical proof.
A notice appears when the view reaches the double-precision limit; zooming deeper adds no new detail.
Save the current view as a favorite and restore it with one click; export runs as a cancellable task with per-row progress.
